# Isaiah Chapter 33 -- The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

## Consensus Translation

*[Full consensus translation of all 24 verses]*

*Destroyer destroyed; God exalted; sinners in Zion tremble; eyes see the king; Zion at peace*

---

## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Isaiah chapter 33 (Woe to the Destroyer) addresses destroyer destroyed; god exalted; sinners in zion tremble; eyes see the king; zion at peace. The key verse — "Your eyes will see the king in his beauty; they will behold a land that stretches afar" — captures the chapter's central message. This chapter belongs to First Isaiah (chs. 1-39), focused on judgment and the Assyrian crisis.
